source.title: Derry Journal, 18 October 1946, p. 7 ("Notice of result of elections, County Borough of Londonderry: election of aldermen and councillors")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: no poll taken: declared duly elected in the Returning Officer's notice of result (Derry Journal, 18 October 1946, p7)

note: Election of the whole Londonderry Corporation (North and South Wards two aldermen and six councillors each, Waterside one alderman and three councillors) under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946; nominations closed Tuesday 1 October and the poll was on Wednesday 16 October 1946 (Returning Officer's notice of election, Derry Journal, 23 September 1946), results declared shortly after midnight. The councillorships in North and South were contested; the aldermen and the Waterside councillors had no poll. The Unionists kept the North Ward and so their 12 to 8 majority, while the six Derry Labour Party and Anti-Partition candidates took the South Ward (Derry Journal, 18 October 1946). Returned unopposed.
